name: codex-delegate
description: Delegate one bounded coding task from Claude Code to the Codex CLI. The Claude Code plugin installs PreToolUse hooks that read every Bash, Monitor, and Workflow call's text; its PermissionRequest hook is inert. The npm package ships only the standalone launcher and project documents. The launcher runs bounded teardown of the Codex process group and reports CLEANUP_FAILED if the group survives. Prompts and files Codex reads are sent to OpenAI using your ChatGPT Codex allowance or API-billed usage. Requires macOS, /usr/bin/env with -S support, a python3 on PATH that starts with -I -S, and an installed, signed-in Codex CLI.
